card.name: Linking words before diabetes terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, for, or and of that come right before a diabetes-related term like diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperglycemia. Seen mostly in immune-therapy warnings about type 1 diabetes.

modes.label: present with
modes.description: The word with after 'can present' just before diabetic ketoacidosis.
modes.example: Type I Diabetes Mellitus, which can present<< with>> Diabetic Ketoacidosis: Monitor patients

modes.label: The call to monitor for
modes.description: For or or after 'monitor patients' or 'hyperglycemia', leading into hyperglycemia or diabetes signs.
modes.example: Monitor patients<< for>> hyperglycemia or other signs and

modes.label: symptoms of
modes.description: The word of after symptoms, before a blood-sugar condition.
modes.example: Patients who develop symptoms<< of>> hyperglycemia during treatment with at

card.writes: Little clear meaning; it may favor name pieces like Gate or Vig and disfavor 'ed' pieces.
card.plain: It responds to the small word just before diabetes or high blood sugar terms in warning text.
